items.text:
Alcaraz beat Shelton for the 4th time in 5 meetings, 7–6, 7–5 in the final. Set 1 went to a tiebreak, won by Alcaraz. Alcaraz served well, landing 72% of his first serves, compared with his 64% average on hard over the last 52 weeks, and won 71% of his first-serve points (40 of 56). He hit 33 winners and made 27 unforced errors. Shelton struggled on his first serve, winning 64% of the points (33 of 52), compared with his 76% average on hard over the last 52 weeks.

Alcaraz: W: 33 / UE: 27 | DR: 1.25

Shelton: W: 25 / UE: 26 | DR: 0.80
